background: A former West Virginia point guard, Mazzulla was head coach at Division II Fairmont State (2017-19) before joining the Celtics' staff in 2019. He became interim head coach in September 2022 after Ime Udoka's suspension and permanent head coach in February 2023. His Celtics went 57-25 (lost ECF in seven to Miami), 64-18 with the 2024 title at age 35 (youngest title-winning coach since Bill Russell), and 61-21 in 2024-25 before Jayson Tatum's Achilles tear and a second-round loss to New York; 182-64 regular season and 33-17 playoffs through 2024-25. He signed a multi-year extension in 2025. His 'Mazzulla Ball' is the league's purest expected-value offense: record three-point volume, five-out spacing, few turnovers, no fouling, and a famous refusal to call timeouts during opponent runs. After the 2025 roster teardown (Holiday, Porzingis traded; Horford, Kornet gone) and Tatum's absence, Boston still reached the 2026 playoffs (final result unverified).
